metadata.description: Resource name prefix. Becomes part of every resource name. 3-15 chars, lowercase letters + digits + hyphens.
Azure region for all resources.

Release channel to deploy. **stable** = the last cut release tag (recommended for production). **edge** = the latest main-branch build — includes newer fixes and features but less testing. To pin to a specific version (e.g. 5.3.0), use webImageOverride / workerImageOverride below instead.
Advanced: override the web image with an explicit reference (e.g. ghcr.io/fortigi/identity-atlas:5.3.0). Leave blank to use the channel selection above.
Advanced: override the worker image with an explicit reference. Leave blank to use the channel selection above.
Sizing profile. xs ≈ €45/mo (demo). s ≈ €79/mo (small production, default). m ≈ €113/mo (mid + staging slot). l ≈ €244/mo (large + GP Postgres). xl ≈ €469/mo (enterprise).
Optional: existing Log Analytics workspace resource ID. Leave empty to create a new one (~€3/mo). Deployer needs Log Analytics Reader on the workspace.
Optional: existing Log Analytics customer ID (GUID). Provide as a fallback when the deployer cannot read the workspace.
Optional: existing Log Analytics shared key. Required if customer ID is provided.
Optional IP CIDR allow-list for the web ingress. Empty = open to internet (relies on Entra/app-level auth).
Force re-run of the bootstrap deployment script on each deploy.
Optional explicit Postgres admin password. Leave blank to derive one from the resource group identity (the default). The value also gets written to Key Vault.
Turn on Entra ID single sign-on. Default = TRUE. When TRUE, entraTenantId and entraClientId must both be provided — the deployment fails otherwise. Set to FALSE only for short-lived demos.
Entra ID tenant (directory) GUID. Required when enableEntraAuth=true. Find it under Entra ID → Overview → Tenant ID.

Entra ID App Registration (client) GUID. Required when enableEntraAuth=true. Create the App Registration BEFORE deploying — add a Single-Page Application redirect URI of https://<namePrefix>-web.azurewebsites.net so users can sign in.
Optional comma-separated list of App role names required to sign in (e.g. IdentityAtlas.Read,IdentityAtlas.Admin). Empty = any signed-in user in the tenant.

variables.pgPassword: [if(empty(parameters('postgresAdminPassword')), format('{0}!Aa1{1}', uniqueString(resourceGroup().id, parameters('namePrefix'), 'pg-base'), take(uniqueString(resourceGroup().id, parameters('namePrefix'), 'pg-x'), 4)), parameters('postgresAdminPassword'))]

properties.scriptContent:
set -euo pipefail

echo "==> Validating Entra ID auth configuration"
if [ "$ENABLE_AUTH" = "true" ]; then
  if [ -z "$AUTH_TENANT_ID" ] || [ -z "$AUTH_CLIENT_ID" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "ERROR: enableEntraAuth=true but entraTenantId and/or entraClientId are empty."
    echo "       Either fill both in (recommended — App Reg + redirect URI must exist first),"
    echo "       or set enableEntraAuth=false to deploy in OPEN mode (anyone with the URL"
    echo "       can access the app)."
    echo ""
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "    auth config OK — tenant=$AUTH_TENANT_ID client=$AUTH_CLIENT_ID"
else
  echo "    auth DISABLED — the app will be reachable by anyone with the URL"
fi

echo "==> Generating master key (if absent)"
if ! az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name identityatlas-master-key >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MASTER_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
  az keyvault secret set \
    --vault-name "$KV_NAME" \
    --name identityatlas-master-key \
    --value "$MASTER_KEY" \
    --output none
  echo "    wrote identityatlas-master-key"
else
  echo "    identityatlas-master-key already present, skipping"
fi

echo "==> Storing postgres admin password (always overwrites — same value passed to the Postgres module by main.bicep)"
az keyvault secret set \
  --vault-name "$KV_NAME" \
  --name postgres-admin-password \
  --value "$PG_PASS_TO_STORE" \
  --output none
echo "    wrote postgres-admin-password"

echo "==> Done"
